title: Chinese People Born in America
synopsis: Merging American and Chinese culture. This is the Intermediate level winning text for our “Chinese Story” event, written by 汪如诗.

fullText.simplified:
美国出生的中国人

    美国有很多从中国移民过来的人，他们的孩子是在美国出生的。因为这些孩子是在美国出生的中国人，所以很多人叫他们：ABCs。
    很多美国人认为ABCs都会说流利的中文，因为他们看起来很像中国人，但其实并非如此。虽然每个ABC不一样，比方说有些去过中文学校，但是有很多ABCs是完全不知道怎么读中文和写中文的。大多数的ABCs能听得懂中文，可是不太会说。我知道这一点，因为我就是这样的ABC。
    ABCs在美国文化中长大，跟他们父母的中国文化背景非常不同。对ABCs来说，很难在两种文化中找到平衡。有些人会推开中国文化，也有些人会更努力地了解这种文化。每个ABC都有自己的想法，比如他们觉得自己是美国人还是中国人，或者两者都是。
fullText.traditional:
美國出生的中國人

    美國有很多從中國移民過來的人，他們的孩子是在美國出生的。因為這些孩子是在美國出生的中國人，所以很多人叫他們：ABCs。
    很多美國人認為ABCs都會說流利的中文，因為他們看起來很像中國人，但其實並非如此。雖然每個ABC不一樣，比方說有些去過中文學校，但是有很多ABCs是完全不知道怎麼讀中文和寫中文的。大多數的ABCs能聽得懂中文，可是不太會說。我知道這一點，因為我就是這樣的ABC。
    ABCs在美國文化中長大，跟他們父母的中國文化背景非常不同。對ABCs來說，很難在兩種文化中找到平衡。有些人會推開中國文化，也有些人會更努力地瞭解這種文化。每個ABC都有自己的想法，比如他們覺得自己是美國人還是中國人，或者兩者都是。

sentences.english: For ABCs, it’s very difficult to find a balance within these two cultures.

sentences.traditional: 也有些人會更努力地瞭解這種文化。

sentences.english: Some people will push away the Chinese culture, ..

sentences.simplified: 每个ABC都有自己的想法，比如他们觉得自己是美国人还是中国人，或者两者都是。
sentences.traditional: 每個ABC都有自己的想法，比如他們覺得自己是美國人還是中國人，或者兩者都是。

Every ABC has their own view. For example, whether they feel they are American or Chinese, or both.

raw.synopsis: Merging American and Chinese culture. This is the Intermediate level winning text for our “Chinese Story” event, written by 汪如诗.
sentence_translations: There are a lot of people that have immigrated to America from China. Their children are born in the US.
Because these children are American born Chinese, many people call them ABCs.
A lot of Americans believe that all ABCs can speak fluent Chinese, because they really look like Chinese people.
But actually, this isn’t the case. Although every ABC is different, some have gone to Chinese school for example ..
.. there are a lot of ABCs that don’t know how to read and write Chinese at all.
The great majority of ABCs can understand spoken Chinese, but can’t really speak.
I know about this, because I am one of these ABCs.
ABCs have grown up within American culture, which is vastly different from their parents’ Chinese cultural background.
For ABCs, it’s very difficult to find a balance within these two cultures.
Some people will push away the Chinese culture, ..
.. and there are other people that will try even harder to know this culture well.
Every ABC has their own view. For example, whether they feel they are American or Chinese, or both.
